reviews.title: The gota sits beautifully
reviews.body: Wore this to a cousin's pheras in Jaipur. The ivory reads well in daylight and the blouse stitching is impeccable. Took one small alteration at the waist.

reviews.title: Pallu is museum-grade
reviews.body: The zardozi is dense without being stiff. Draped easily. Blouse needed a dart — expected at this price.

reviews.title: Perfect for a day wedding
reviews.body: Light, packed well for a flight to Udaipur. Wish the dupatta had a touch more weight.

reviews.title: The only Nehru I keep
reviews.body: Cut is sharp. Wore it to a board dinner and a sangeet the same week. Will order navy next.

reviews.title: Runs a full size small
reviews.body: Beautiful embroidery but 38 was unwearable. Returning.

reviews.title: Bridal red that isn't costume
reviews.body: Held the gota through a 14-hour wedding day. Dupatta needed pins — that's on me.

reviews.title: Quietly special
reviews.body: Wore sage to a cocktail in Goa. Embroidery is tonal — people noticed up close.

reviews.title: Pretty, strap is short
reviews.body: The potli is lovely but I couldn't wear it on the wrist comfortably.

pages.title: About the atelier
pages.excerpt: A house built around Indian craft — silk, gota, zardozi, and block print.
pages.body:
We work with karigars across Varanasi, Lucknow, Kutch, and Jaipur. Every collection starts on the floor of the atelier, not in a trend deck.

The shop is meant to feel like a quiet appointment: considered pieces, honest making, and clothes that hold a wedding week.

pages.title: Contact
pages.excerpt: Appointments, alterations, and the studio desk.
pages.body:
Flagship: Mehrauli, New Delhi
Appointments: appointments@reenarathore.admin
WhatsApp: +91 99993 13366

Store hours: 11:00–20:00, Tuesday to Sunday.

pages.title: Shipping policy
pages.excerpt: Domestic dispatch in 2–5 days for ready-to-ship; made-to-order in 4–6 weeks.
pages.body:
Ready-to-ship pieces leave the atelier within two to five working days. Made-to-order bridal and couture follows the date on your confirmation.

We ship with Delhivery and Bluedart. International orders are quoted at checkout.

pages.title: Returns policy
pages.excerpt: Ready-to-ship ready-to-wear: 7 days, unworn, tags on.
pages.body:
Ready-to-ship garments may be returned within seven days if unworn, unaltered, and with tags attached. Bridal, made-to-order, and jewellery on consignment cannot be returned.

Start a return from your order page. We arrange pickup in most metros.

pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.body: We collect only what we need to fulfil orders, appointments, and care. We do not sell lists. Payment is processed by our banking partners; we never store full card numbers.

pages.title: Terms of use
pages.body: By placing an order you agree to the making timeline on the product page, the returns policy, and the alteration terms shared at checkout.

pages.title: How a gota border is built
pages.excerpt: Ribbon, stitch, and the weeks it takes to finish a lehenga skirt.
pages.body: Gota is not appliqué. It is ribbon laid, then held, then secured in rows that have to sit true around a flare. This is a studio note from Jaipur.
